Ryme Wharf (Japanese: ライム Ryme Wharf) is a wharf located in South Water, a district south of central Ryme in the game . Its port is located in the western side of Ryme Harbor . Goods from all over the world are stored in the many warehouses located around the area. Most of Chapter 7 takes place here.
